# Immutable private source snapshots authorized for external private-only CI.
# Empty by default: no source revision is approved for transfer.
# Each approved entry must be security-reviewed on protected source main.
# Format: <source commit> <source root tree> <destination repo ID> <carrier main commit> <carrier root tree>
# Approving a destination alone never approves an arbitrary PR/source revision.
# Carrier pins make source authorization expire whenever protected carrier code/workflows change.\n
